categories.sensor_usd_cad_appearance: Gemini335L certified camera USD; OS0 family exterior and REV6/REV7 family USD
categories.measurement_models_configs: Gemini asset contains NVIDIA depth sensor metadata; Stage 2 smoke deliberately uses explicit ideal stereo proxy and generic rotary64 config
categories.algorithm_source: none downloaded in Stage 2; existing project import/smoke code only
categories.pretrained_weights: none downloaded; asset import and measurement smoke require no learned model

truth_boundaries: Orbbec Gemini335L vendor USD is preserved and referenced as appearance/digital-twin evidence.
OS0 USD only exposes REV6/REV7; the target REV8 64-channel behavior remains a parameterized proxy.
Two camera prims or vendor depth output do not prove SDK stereo matching.
The project proxy does not model active IR, rolling shutter, factory beam calibration or hardware clocks.
